maria: Heads-up: PR #41298 touches runtime routing fallback, orchestration config, and auth header ordering. Need owners from runtime/platform/infra/security. Who can take merge stewardship? https://git.redwood/pr/41298 :wave:
sam: I can take runtime perf sign-off. Need perf/regression results + canary plan. @chen can infra take allocator/eviction review? :+1:
chen: I can handle infra + staging tests. Please add e2e steps. Small flag change:
```
service.config.enable_eviction_preference = true
```
jordan: security note — auth header ordering tweak. Need threat model + migration notes. @maria can you add rollback steps?
maria: Added a short rollback runbook + smoke tests in the PR description. Canary window preference: Tue 9–11am PT. Sam — can you run the perf job (link in PR)?
sam: On it. I'll run perf suite and post numbers by EOD today. If token latency delta < 3% we'll be ok. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled for 2025-05-06T16:00:00Z. I'll ping 30m before.
chen: Infra LGTM pending one nit in allocator comment. Will post LGTM after QA pass.
jordan: Security provisional +1 with two monitoring alerts to add. Need explicit sec-ops approval before merge. Adding @sec-ops.
sec-ops: sec-ops: We'll review tonight; if nothing unexpected, okay for canary with stricter alerting. CC'ed SOC on-call.
maria: Owners confirmed: sam (runtime perf), chen (infra), jordan (security), maria (merge steward). If we have explicit LGTM by tomorrow 10am PT I'll queue merge in the window. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
